name: thaler-promo-video
description: Thaler videos: a 32 s promo and a 60 s tutorial, rendered from HTML/GSAP with original synthesized soundtracks.

scripts.render:guide: node render.mjs --page guide.html --cues && python3 music.py guide && node render.mjs --page guide.html
scripts.render:ad: python3 -I music.py ad && node render.mjs --page ad.html && cp out/ad-music.wav out/ad-wide-music.wav && node render.mjs --page 'ad.html#wide'
